bachelor_required.value: Undergraduate degree in related field with high academic standing; course-based min 70% (B) for CS/related degrees

bachelor_field.value: CS/SE/CompE or equivalent; related (Math, Stats, Physics, Engineering) with CS 454 co-requisite; less technical (incl. Earth/Environmental Science) admitted at >=75% (B+)
bachelor_field.quote: a less technical background such as a Bachelor's in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Earth/Environmental Science, Finance, Economics... no less than our 75% (B+)

non_cs_eligible.quote: Earth/Environmental Science ... provided that their undergraduate academic standing is no less than 75% (B+)

non_cs_notes.value: Course-based stream accepts less technical backgrounds at 75%+; MAT 200 and CS 454 assigned as preparatory co-requisites

prerequisites.value: MAT 200 and CS 454 preparatory co-requisites for non-CS applicants

min_gpa.value: 75% (B+) for less technical backgrounds; 70% for CS degrees

english_waiver.value: Yes: not required if English is first language or applicant attended at least one year of university in an English-language institution

other_requirements.value: Transcript, statement of research interests, ID, program pre-approval form; thesis stream needs pre-application and supervisor

program_type.value: Course-based: 12 one-term 500-level courses plus Master's project CS 590 (project only in spring/summer)

eligibility_notes: Provisional: explicitly admits Earth/Environmental Science (non-CS) at 75% (B+) in the course-based stream with MAT 200 and CS 454 prerequisites; whether a Nigerian 2:1 equals 75% is unconfirmed. English waiver via English-language university. Experience pathway, fees, deadline, tuition UNKNOWN. Curriculum is theory-leaning (prior note), low cloud relevance.
